ticks.note: `up` is true from tick 1. `Stairs` enters `Ground` and stops there: its transition is delayed, so it is not checked in `Ground`'s entry tick. `Lift` enters `Ground` too, but its transition is immediate: it fires at once, and so does `First`'s, so `Lift` ends tick 1 in `Second` with `floor` 2.
`Stairs` checks `Ground`'s transition now: it climbs to `First`, and `floor` is 1. `First` was entered in this tick, so its delayed transition waits. `Lift` is already at the top.
`Stairs` reaches `Second`, two ticks after `Lift`: a chain of delayed transitions moves at most one step per tick.
Both charts are in `Second`, which has no outgoing transitions.
